fit.title: Choose your size
fit.chartNote: US and UK sizes are approximate conversions. Sizes are ordered by EU size.
fit.invalidLength: Enter your foot length as a number.
fit.outOfRange: This measurement is outside our size chart. Please contact us about sizing.
fit.resultHelp: Based on the size chart. If you are between sizes, choose the larger size.
fit.sizeNotOffered: This size is not available in this style.

steps.1: Place a sheet of paper against a wall on a hard, level floor.
steps.2: Wear the socks you intend to wear with the boots. Stand on the paper with your heel against the wall.
steps.3: Mark the tip of your longest toe on the paper.
steps.4: Measure the distance from the wall to the mark. This is your foot length.
steps.5: Measure both feet and use the longer measurement.

fit.tipEvening: Measure your feet at the end of the day, when they are at their largest.
fit.tipBetween: If you are between sizes, choose the larger size.
fit.tipWide: If you have wide feet, choose the larger size or contact us before ordering.
